args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1), with a production error rate of 18% across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. The service was rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The initial rollback attempt partially failed (us-east completed, then the orchestrator halted the rollout); a retry completed the rollback in us-west and eu-west. Post-rollback, checkout-api is healthy in all regions (v2.3.0, error rate 0.2%). v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause of the health check failures is identified and fixed.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The incident was actually created despite the timeout (INC-0001, SEV2, open) — no duplicate needed. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Rollback:**
- checkout-api's latest release, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in all production regions (18% error rate).
- Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production.
- The first rollback attempt partially failed (only us-east completed before an orchestrator error halted the rollout); a retry completed us-west and eu-west.
- Verified post-rollback: checkout-api is now running v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), healthy, with error rate down to 0.2%.

**Incident:**
- Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api documenting the v2.3.1 health check failures, the rollback to v2.3.0 (including the partial failure and retry), and a note that v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause is identified.

No approval was needed since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production.
